chain.title: A Blade For Clearing
chain.desc: Iron and a stick. Machetes are this mod's own tool class - they sweep through fungus and vines the way a sword never could, and they are the only way to harvest propelplant safely.

chain.title: Smelting On Blackstone
chain.desc: Eight blackstone. The Nether has no cobblestone, so the first furnace a Nether-native build can make is this one.

chain.title: The Cut Off A Hoglin
chain.desc: Hoglins drop loin through data/nethersdelight/loot_modifiers/hoglin.json. The Nether's only farmable large animal finally yields a proper cut.

chain.title: Loin, Seared
chain.desc: Campfire, furnace or smoker. It feeds far better than the vanilla cooked porkchop a hoglin normally drops.

chain.title: Skinning The Herd
chain.desc: Cut from a hoglin with a knife, or scavenged through scavenging_hide_from_hoglin.json. It also cuts down into plain leather.

chain.title: Mounted On The Wall
chain.desc: Hoglin hide with planks, wool and gold nuggets. Nether's Delight's only decorative trophy, and the mod's completion marker for the hoglin line.

chain.title: Stuffed Whole
chain.desc: Hoglin hide and loin packed with ham, nether salad, crimson fungus and both root types. The largest single assembly in the mod.

chain.title: The Feast Block
chain.desc: The stuffed hoglin cooked. It serves several players from one block, which is what Farmer's Delight feasts are for.

chain.title: Carving A Strider
chain.desc: Striders drop slices through strider.json, and ground strider cuts into more. Nobody expected the lava taxi to be edible.

chain.title: Strider Over Coals
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: raw strider with crimson and warped fungus and roots. It needs both Nether forests, which forces you to travel.

chain.title: Stewed With Moss
chain.desc: The other strider dish, built from the same four fungal ingredients.

chain.title: The Cane That Wants To Explode
chain.desc: Cut propelplant on a board and it also yields gunpowder. It grows on soul soil and is the mod's one genuinely novel crop.

chain.title: The Seed Of The Blast
chain.desc: Propelpearls are the propelplant's fruit and the reagent for the torch, the skewer and the magma gelatin.

chain.title: A Torch That Launches
chain.desc: Propelpearl and propelplant cane. Thrown, it plants light at range - the most useful thing in the mod for exploring a Nether ceiling.

chain.title: Soil Worth Planting
chain.desc: Rich soul soil is what propelplant needs to grow well, and the Nether's answer to Farmer's Delight's rich soil.

chain.title: Composting Without Grass
chain.desc: Bone meal, soul soil, twisting vines and warped roots - or hoglin hide instead of the roots. The Nether has no compostable greenery, so this is the substitute.

chain.title: On A Blaze Rod
chain.desc: Blaze rod, propelpearl and raw strider. A skewer that needs a Fortress kill to assemble.

chain.title: Set With Lava
chain.desc: Cooking Pot: a lava bucket, magma cream and a propelpearl. The strangest dessert in the Farmer's Delight ecosystem.

chain.title: Farming The Crimson
chain.desc: Knife a crimson fungus into a colony block. Colonies regrow, which turns a one-shot fungus into a renewable farm.

chain.title: The Flower That Is Not A Flower
chain.desc: Mimicarnation is Nether's Delight's decorative plant, and the only flower the Nether grows on its own terms.

notes: 34 ids resolve as assets/nethersdelight/models/item/<id>.json intersected with item./block. lang keys. Mob drops verified in data/nethersdelight/loot_modifiers/: hoglin.json (hoglin_loin), strider.json (strider_slice), scavenging_hide_from_hoglin.json (hoglin_hide), plus chopping modifiers that make hoglins and pigs give farmersdelight:ham and smoked_ham on the cutting board. The machete is this mod's own tool type and is what the propelplant and fungus harvesting is balanced around; iron/gold/diamond/netherite versions all exist and the iron and gold ones can be smelted back to nuggets. One id used as an ingredient in several recipes - nethersdelight:raw_strider - has no item model in this jar version and so failed the set check; strider_slice, ground_strider and grilled_strider are used instead. The three potted/berry lang-only entries (potted_mimicarnation, propelplant_berry_cane, propelplant_berry_stem) are block states rather than obtainable items and are excluded. Parent items this addon assumes you already have: farmersdelight:cutting_board, farmersdelight:cooking_pot, farmersdelight:ham, farmersdelight:nether_salad, farmersdelight:rich_soil, any forge:tools/knives knife, Nether access with crimson and warped forests.
